verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no CI runners of its own. It integrates with Buildkite and shows those builds on a repository's CI tab and as pull-request checks, and GitHub Actions results from synced repositories arrive as checks. That gives some centralized visibility, but execution is delegated to external CI systems. missing for 10: GitCafe platform-hosted runners, first-party self-hosted/private runner registration and management, a native pipeline execution engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
